transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, what really made me come in is... I've been having this issue at work. I'm a retail buyer, and lately I just can't shake the feeling that people at work, and even some of our vendors, are tracking my buys. It feels like they're messing with the launch numbers behind my back just to make me look stupid. My supervisor actually sat down and showed me the reports to prove that's not happening, but... I don't know, I just can't stop thinking that they are.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?

Yeah, I have. Um... sometimes when I'm in the stockroom at work, or if I'm driving back from a vendor meeting, I'll hear a man's voice. It sounds like it's coming from right behind me. He says things like, "Move faster, Scott," or he just laughs at my picks. But whenever I turn around to look, nobody is ever there.
About how long have you been experiencing these things?
Um... I'd say it's been roughly ten months now. Both the feeling that people are messing with my numbers and hearing that voice... yeah, it's been about ten months.
During these past ten months, have you been experiencing persistent feelings of sadness or depression?
No, I wouldn't say so. Um... I haven't really felt sad or down. It's mostly just been a lot of stress with the whole work situation, but not depressed, no.
Have you had any periods where you felt unusually energized, revved up, or felt like you needed much less sleep than usual?

Yeah, actually, I have. Um... there have been plenty of weeks where I only sleep maybe three or four hours a night. But I don't feel tired at all. I'll just wake up feeling totally wired and ready to go. It just feels like lying in bed is wasting time, you know? Like it's time I could use to make moves and get things done instead of just sleeping.
Have there been periods during these ten months when you were hearing the voices or felt people were sabotaging your work, but your energy levels and sleep were completely normal?

Yeah, there were. Um... I remember a calmer stretch where I was actually sleeping normally and didn't feel like I was, you know, running the whole market. But even then, for a few weeks during that time, I still totally believed people were tracking my buys. And I was definitely still hearing that voice when I was back in the stockroom.
